name: Build orchestrator
author: Brett
description: Breaks every build into small steps (30 min or less), each pinned to Fable or Opus, and runs the build pipeline (Brett, Nov 8 2026): every build gets an id and a Claude split (Fable only where needed) and sits in Pending; Brett moves it to the Queue; the dispatcher (pipeline.mjs on the VPS, every minute) watches the Claude accounts (which have Fable, parallel per account) and the agent slots and, when a slot is free, starts a headless session for the next Queue build on an account that runs its next phase's model. The only place that browses and manages builds (Brett, Nov 10 2026; the Build manager is retired): tabs Pending, Queue (each build's steps, planned model and account), Active, Incomplete, Complete, Errors, then Accounts (health every 5 minutes: sign-in, credits, Fable), All builds, Approvals and Rules. When a build's turn comes the dispatcher makes the final account pick, subscriptions first (in Brett's order), then any API account, moving on until one accepts, and records which account took it. Tracker is the one builds store, _claude/builds/store.json, so any session or account continues the build (orchestrator.mjs next | brief | act; pipeline.mjs status | queue | unqueue | split | tick). Package builds window (build-package@1): tick waiting steps (Fable by default) from any build, combine them into one package build, then send it to a helper or queue it here; the order is re-analyzed after every send. Build optimizer (build-optimize@1): Optimize builds repacks every waiting step into the fewest builds (Basic = plain code, zero tokens; Deep = an AI review when connected, falls back to Basic), lists the new package of builds to confirm, applies it in one transaction with one undo, and moves steps between builds by drag and drop anywhere.

items.title: Build priorities
items.description: Every build's priority tag (Urgent, High, Normal, Low = P0-P3) and how many things wait on it.

items.title: What's waiting on a build
items.description: A build's priority and everything waiting for it: builds behind it in the agent queue, builds that depend on it, PRs stacked on it or behind it in the merge queue, UI Review items, linked plans. Say 'what's waiting on skins'.
items.output: { id, title, priority, label, waiting: [{ kind, id, title, why }] }

items.title: Headless runs and start tokens
items.description: A build's headless runs: start tokens (the context of the first request), cost, brief only or full chain, tools and MCP servers loaded. Say 'what did skins start with'.
items.output: { build, runs: [{ session, briefOnly, startTokens, startCostUsd, costUsd, at }] }

items.title: Set build priority
items.description: Set the priority of one or more builds: 'make banner widgets urgent'. Higher priority starts first in the agent queue and lands first in the merge queue; Brett's manual moves still win.

priority.description: urgent, high, normal, low or P0-P3

items.title: What Brett said
items.description: The verbatim words Brett used to start a build (build-origin@1): when, where, who launched it, the brief and later addenda.

items.title: Record what Brett said
items.description: Record Brett's verbatim words on a build that has none (backfilled ones give way); his words are never replaced: use origin-addendum for a later change.

said.description: Brett's exact words, verbatim and unedited (never a paraphrase)

items.title: Add what Brett said later
items.description: Append a later change Brett asked for (verbatim) to a build's origin.

said.description: Brett's exact words, verbatim and unedited (never a paraphrase)

items.title: Pipeline status
items.description: The build pipeline: what is Pending, in the Queue and Building, every Claude account (Fable yes or no, how many run on it), the agent slots, and what the dispatcher's next tick will start or why it waits. Say 'what's in the queue' or 'is anything building'.
items.output: { table: { pending, queued, building }, accounts, accountsFrom: { source, at, ageMin, why }, slots, plan: { launches, waits, idle }, state: { selfCheck, selfCheckRequested, … } }

items.title: Dispatcher self-check
items.description: Ask the dispatcher to check every Claude account one by one (signed in, limited, API key saved and not rejected, free slots), release slots and builds held by sessions that ended, and rebuild its account list. Runs on the VPS on the next tick (within a minute); the result shows on the Pipeline tab and in pipeline status (state.selfCheck), and AmberX hears when it fixed something or found an account it can't use. Say 'check the build accounts' or 'why is nothing building'.

reason.description: Why the check was asked for

items.output: { ran: false, requested, last: { at, line, fixes, problems, findings } }

items.title: Orchestrator tab
items.description: One of the orchestrator's tabs: pending, queue, active, incomplete, complete or errors, with each build's steps, planned model and account, and the account that took it. Say 'what's in the queue' or 'show build errors'.
items.output: { tab, rows: [{ id, title, status, steps, stepList, pipeline: { planned, account, pickedAt, tried } }] }

items.title: Claude account health
items.description: The last account health sweep (every 5 minutes, headless, never touches a build): per account, can sign in, has credits, accepts Fable. Say 'are the accounts healthy'.
items.output: { health: { at, line, problems, accounts: [{ name, kind, signedIn, credits, fable, error }] }, every }

items.title: Check the Claude accounts now
items.description: Run the account health sweep now (the dispatcher starts it within a minute, in the background). Say 'check the accounts now'.

items.title: Queue a build
items.description: Move a Pending build to the Queue: the dispatcher starts it when a slot and an account for its model are free. Say 'queue the icon browser build'.

items.title: Take a build out of the Queue
items.description: Move a queued build back to Pending before it starts.

items.title: Split a build into steps
items.description: Ask the orchestrator to split (or re-split) a build into steps of 30 minutes or less, Fable only where needed; done by the dispatcher within a minute.

items.title: Ask for a build
items.description: File a build with the orchestrator and put it in the Queue: the orchestrator is the only thing that starts builds; it assigns the id, splits it and the dispatcher launches it on the right account and model. Say 'build me …'.

queue.description: Straight to the Queue (default true); false = Pending

items.title: Route a build to API or subscriptions
items.description: Where one build may run: api (API-key accounts only, billed per token under their daily and weekly caps; Brett's own click), subscription (never an API account) or auto (subscriptions, API only by the overflow rule).

items.title: Pipeline settings
items.description: The dispatcher's settings, including the API overflow rule (apiOverflow) and which API accounts it may use.

items.title: Change pipeline settings
items.description: Change dispatcher settings. apiOverflow = when every subscription account is full or out, send builds to an API-key account (off by default; turning it on is Brett's own click, anyone may turn it off).

items.title: Steps waiting to be packaged
items.description: Every waiting step of every build (pending, running, waiting; not the step a build is on now) plus ready Plan Studio plans, grouped by source build, with model, thinking, areas, estimate, filters, helpers and the caller's role (build-package@1). Secondary sessions get nothing.
items.output: { candidates, skipped, facets, helpers, role, canSend }

items.title: Package steps into one build
items.description: Combine the ticked steps (order = priority; steps of one build keep their order) into one build package, linked to its sources (they show 'packaged into'). Then add it to this orchestrator at `position` (0 = top) or send it to a helper (dest helper, to, now = top of its list). Re-analyzes the order and posts to the Breakroom Sessions channel. Owner-only on the primary; raising Opus steps to Fable needs Brett's click.

order.description: ticked step keys (<build>/<step uid>), priority order

confirmed.description: true once the ticked list was shown and confirmed

now.description: do it now: top priority on that helper

said.description: Brett's exact words, if he asked for this package

items.title: Send a package to a helper
items.description: Offer an existing package to a helper session through Session sync (`to`, `now`), then re-analyze the order.

items.title: Unpackage
items.description: A package with nothing done goes back to its builds: its steps return to them and the package build is removed.

items.title: Re-analyze the build order
items.description: Re-check the queue order against every package (a package after the steps it needs, before the steps that need it; running and pinned builds never move). apply: false previews.

items.title: Optimize builds
items.description: Repack every waiting step (queued, pending, plan-ready, unstarted steps of running builds) into the fewest builds: Deep mode (AI review) when an AI connection is there, else Basic (plain code, zero tokens). Returns the proposed new package of builds with every step, reasoning, flags and a summary. Nothing changes until it is applied with optimize-apply after Brett confirms. Filters: e.g. models ['Fable'] + profiles ['main-framework'] for 'just the Fable work in Main framework'.

preset.description: safe | aggressive | fable-only | a saved preset

settings.description: settings for this run (mode, maxSteps, maxMinutes, maxBuilds, target fewest|balanced|fastest, rules, safety, drops, naming, notify)

filter.description: which waiting steps are in scope

estimateOnly.description: Deep mode: only the token estimate

items.output: { plan: { packs, summary, flags, warnings, mode, run }, items, ai, notified }

items.title: Build optimizer settings and runs
items.description: The optimizer's settings, presets, saved filter, last run (which mode ran), the runs that can be undone, and whether Deep mode (AI) can run.

items.title: Apply an optimizer plan
items.description: Apply the plan Brett confirmed: one new build per pack with the steps moved over (linked back to their old builds), emptied builds archived, every store, list and screen updated in one transaction plus live push. One undo (optimize-undo). Owner-only on the primary.

items.title: Undo the optimizer
items.description: Undo the last optimizer run or step move (or `run`): the builds it made go, every build it changed comes back. Refused when work has happened since.

items.title: Move steps between builds
items.description: Move steps (keys <build>/<step uid>, several at once) into another build at a position. Running steps never move; a step keeps its model. One undo.

items.title: Build optimizer settings
items.description: Change the optimizer's settings or saved filter (never-touch-running and confirm stay locked on), or save / delete a named preset (preset + op).

settings.description: settings for this run (mode, maxSteps, maxMinutes, maxBuilds, target fewest|balanced|fastest, rules, safety, drops, naming, notify)

filter.description: which waiting steps are in scope
